facility.name: Tahnee Scott
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization: The provider reported an incident involving a child who was transported to the hospital and received medical treatment five days after the incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §747.303(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact EMS: A child experienced a brief febrile seizure while in care and did not promptly return to their normal level of responsiveness.  Emergency personnel were contacted 13 minutes after the incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact EMS (26 TAC §747.3405(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A child enrolled on 1/5/26 and 4 mos of age did not have a shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The provider is missing 3 hours of management training an instructor-lead training.      This is a re-cite.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: One out of five child files evaulated did not have an admission form on file.  The child began attending in October 2025.  Another child in attendance did not have an enrollment file including admission form, medical and transportation authorizations, immunizations or health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The provider completed 27 out of 30 annual training hours.  Provider was missing 3 hours of management training and was missing instructor-lead training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: One out of four child files evaluated during the monitoring inspection on 1/23/2025 has not been obtained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The provider's First Aid and CPR certificate expired 11/17/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The provider's dog was last vaccinated 11/22/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: The provider did not have a record of attendance for the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: 4 out of 6 child files evaluated did not have a health statement on file.  Children had been in attendance for over 12 mos.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The primary caregiver had completed 0 out of 30 annual training hours for the evaluation period 2/14/24-1/14/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 3 out of 6 child files were missing updated vaccination records.    NOTE:  One child's updated immunization record was delivered during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A record of monthly fire drills conduct was not available for inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: A signed medical authorization form was not available for Over The Counter medication kept at the operation for a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §747.3603(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: A 7 mos old in care did not have a written feeding plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Not After Expiration date: Over The Counter Medication for a child in care expired 8/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Not After Expiration date (26 TAC §747.3605(b)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three out of six child files evaluated did not have current vaccination records.    NOTE:  One child's parent was able to email a current copy of their child's immunization records during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan did not contain information on how non-mobile children will be evacuated during an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care: The emergency preparedness plan did not contain information regarding how the provider will ensure the continuity of care of the children while at the relocation site.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care (26 TAC §747.5003(4))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: A household member did not have a completed orientation on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: A health statement for the family dog was not on file during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence: The liability insurance policy provided with the provider's application had been inactivated due to not being scheduled for auto pay.  A current liability insurance policy had been renewed but was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence (26 TAC §747.209(1))
